title: Bundling .env Configuration File in pubspec.yaml Assets
description: The application declares the local '.env' secret file under the 'flutter: assets:' section of pubspec.yaml, causing all environment secrets to be packaged unencrypted inside the APK's flutter_assets/ directory.
attack_vector: An attacker unzips the distributed APK (`unzip app-release.apk assets/flutter_assets/.env`) and reads production API keys, database URLs, and service secrets in plaintext.
fix_rationale: Remove '.env' from pubspec.yaml assets and inject non-sensitive runtime configuration via compile-time `--dart-define-from-file` or retrieve short-lived credentials from a backend vault.
